last.verdict: Solid beat, but cautious 2027 outlook and rising bank payments left the stock about flat.

reasons.label: Cooler 2027 outlook
reasons.text: Visa guided to low-double-digit revenue growth next year, versus 15% this year; some investors found that modest.

reasons.label: Rising payments to banks
reasons.text: Payments to banks and partners to keep them on Visa jumped 21% to $5.1B; about 25% of volume renews in 2027.

reasons.label: Costs growing faster
reasons.text: Adjusted operating expenses rose 12%, mostly marketing and staff, and 2027 profit growth is guided slightly below revenue growth.

story: Revenue growth has stayed in the low-to-mid teens over the last four reports (15%, 17%, 14%, 13%). Payments to banks have grown faster each time (12%, 18%, 21% in the last three reports I checked). Shares have mostly shrugged off beats, with small dips after hours.
